intro: Zureetha Fargaze is an orc mentor stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar alongside Foreman Thazz'ril. Vigilant against corruption, she directs young Horde recruits to investigate and root out the dark influence of the Burning Blade cult hiding within the valley.

p: While Foreman Thazz'ril oversees the labor and discipline of young orcs and Darkspear trolls, Zureetha Fargaze keeps watch for subtler, more insidious threats. The Burning Blade cult has secretly infiltrated the Valley of Trials, corrupting lesser demons and gathering strength in the nearby cavern of Burning Blade Coven. Zureetha tasks untested adventurers with retrieving medallions from the cultists to confirm their presence and dismantle their early operations before directing seasoned recruits outward into Durotar.
